## 6. Building the donor–fiscal-year dataset

### Annual giving base

The model needs one record per constituent per fiscal year. Individual annual
giving equals positive non-organization direct payments plus positive soft
credits. Legacy payments are handled separately because they are household-
level and predate FY2021.

```{r}
#| label: annual-giving-base

positive_individual_unite_payments <- unite_payments_analysis |>
  filter(!organization_payment, positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date)))

excluded_organization_payments <- unite_payments_analysis |>
  filter(organization_payment, positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date)))

positive_soft_credits <- soft_credits_analysis |>
  filter(positive_amount) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(credit_date)))

direct_payment_transactions <- positive_individual_unite_payments |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(donor_id),
    fiscal_year,
    gift_credit_date = credit_date,
    amount = payment_amount,
    source = "direct_payment"
  )

soft_credit_transactions <- positive_soft_credits |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(soft_credit_constituent_id),
    fiscal_year,
    gift_credit_date = credit_date,
    amount = credit_amount,
    source = "soft_credit"
  )

constituent_giving_transactions <- bind_rows(
  direct_payment_transactions,
  soft_credit_transactions
)

donor_fiscal_year_giving <- constituent_giving_transactions |>
  group_by(constituent_id, fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_giving = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    direct_payment_dollars = sum(amount[source == "direct_payment"], na.rm = TRUE),
    soft_credit_dollars = sum(amount[source == "soft_credit"], na.rm = TRUE),
    direct_payment_count = sum(source == "direct_payment"),
    soft_credit_count = sum(source == "soft_credit"),
    largest_gift = max(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_gift_date = min(gift_credit_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_gift_date = max(gift_credit_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: annual-giving-base-audit

annual_giving_base_audit <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    metric = "Positive individual Unite payments retained",
    rows = nrow(positive_individual_unite_payments),
    dollars = sum(positive_individual_unite_payments$payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Positive organization Unite payments excluded",
    rows = nrow(excluded_organization_payments),
    dollars = sum(excluded_organization_payments$payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Positive soft credits retained",
    rows = nrow(soft_credit_transactions),
    dollars = sum(soft_credit_transactions$amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final combined constituent-giving transactions",
    rows = nrow(constituent_giving_transactions),
    dollars = NA_real_
  ),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final donor-fiscal-year records",
    rows = nrow(donor_fiscal_year_giving),
    dollars = NA_real_
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  annual_giving_base_audit |>
    mutate(rows = scales::comma(rows),
           dollars = if_else(is.na(dollars), NA_character_,
                             scales::dollar(dollars))),
  format = "pipe"
)

organization_payment_audit <- excluded_organization_payments |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    excluded_organization_payment_dollars = sum(payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  full_join(
    positive_soft_credits |>
      group_by(fiscal_year) |>
      summarise(
        retained_soft_credit_dollars = sum(credit_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "fiscal_year"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(excluded_organization_payment_dollars,
             retained_soft_credit_dollars), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    dollar_difference = excluded_organization_payment_dollars -
      retained_soft_credit_dollars
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(organization_payment_audit, format = "pipe", digits = 2)
```

Individual direct payments and soft credits are retained as separate credit
sources; organization payments are excluded before individual-level giving is
constructed and audited against soft-credit dollars by fiscal year.
`designation_detail_id` is not used as a transaction-level deduplication key
because it can occur on many payment records. This analysis does not attempt to
calculate station revenue by summing the two sources. Organization records are
already identified, and their direct payments are excluded from individual-
level giving.

### Eligible donor-year panel and major-donor status

An eligible donor is a constituent with at least one positive, linked PBS Utah
giving record during the available FY2021–FY2026 period. The model will later
exclude donors who are already major donors at the prediction date. This
definition should be confirmed with PBS Utah before deployment.

```{r}
#| label: eligible-donor-year-panel

eligible_donors <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

observed_fiscal_year_bounds <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  transmute(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  summarise(
    first_fiscal_year = min(fiscal_year_number),
    last_fiscal_year = max(fiscal_year_number)
  )

observed_fiscal_years <- paste0(
  "FY",
  seq(observed_fiscal_year_bounds$first_fiscal_year,
      observed_fiscal_year_bounds$last_fiscal_year)
)

donor_fiscal_year_panel <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  constituent_id = eligible_donors$constituent_id,
  fiscal_year = observed_fiscal_years
) |>
  left_join(donor_fiscal_year_giving, by = c("constituent_id", "fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(
    annual_giving = replace_na(annual_giving, 0),
    direct_payment_dollars = replace_na(direct_payment_dollars, 0),
    soft_credit_dollars = replace_na(soft_credit_dollars, 0),
    direct_payment_count = replace_na(direct_payment_count, 0L),
    soft_credit_count = replace_na(soft_credit_count, 0L),
    largest_gift = replace_na(largest_gift, 0),
    gave_this_year = annual_giving > 0,
    is_major_donor = annual_giving >= 1200,
    giving_tier = case_when(
      annual_giving == 0 ~ "No giving",
      annual_giving < 1200 ~ "Under $1,200",
      annual_giving < 2000 ~ "$1,200–$1,999",
      annual_giving < 5000 ~ "$2,000–$4,999",
      annual_giving < 10000 ~ "$5,000–$9,999",
      annual_giving < 15000 ~ "$10,000–$14,999",
      TRUE ~ "$15,000+"
    ),
    giving_tier = factor(
      giving_tier,
      levels = c(
        "No giving", "Under $1,200", "$1,200–$1,999", "$2,000–$4,999",
        "$5,000–$9,999", "$10,000–$14,999", "$15,000+"
      )
    )
  )

donor_fiscal_year_summary <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  donor_fiscal_year_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: eligible-donor-year-panel-plots

ggplot(donor_fiscal_year_summary,
       aes(x = fiscal_year, y = major_donors, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Major-donor count by fiscal year",
    x = "Fiscal year",
    y = "Major donors"
  )

donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  count(fiscal_year, giving_tier, name = "donors") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fiscal_year, y = donors, fill = giving_tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Eligible donor counts by giving tier and fiscal year",
    x = "Fiscal year",
    y = "Eligible donors",
    fill = "Giving tier"
  )
```

### Individual versus organization eligibility check

The constituent table may contain both people and organizations. Because this
project is intended to rank individual major-donor prospects, entity type must
be understood before finalizing the eligible population.

```{r}
#| label: individual-versus-organization-type-checks

constituent_type_frequency <- bind_rows(
  constituents_analysis |>
    filter(!is.na(primary_constituent_type),
           trimws(primary_constituent_type) != "") |>
    count(primary_constituent_type, name = "constituents") |>
    mutate(type_field = "primary_constituent_type",
           type_value = primary_constituent_type) |>
    select(type_field, type_value, constituents),
  constituents_analysis |>
    filter(!is.na(constituent_type), trimws(constituent_type) != "") |>
    count(constituent_type, name = "constituents") |>
    mutate(type_field = "constituent_type", type_value = constituent_type) |>
    select(type_field, type_value, constituents)
) |>
  arrange(type_field, desc(constituents))

organization_pattern <- regex(
  "organization|foundation|business|corporation|trust|estate",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

potential_organization_records <- constituents_analysis |>
  mutate(
    primary_constituent_type = as.character(primary_constituent_type),
    constituent_type = as.character(constituent_type)
  ) |>
  filter(
    str_detect(coalesce(primary_constituent_type, ""), organization_pattern) |
      str_detect(coalesce(constituent_type, ""), organization_pattern)
  ) |>
  select(constituent_id, primary_constituent_type, constituent_type)

knitr::kable(
  constituent_type_frequency |>
    mutate(constituents = scales::comma(constituents)),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  head(potential_organization_records, 20),
  format = "pipe",
  caption = "First 20 potential organization records for review"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: individual-versus-organization-giving-checks

organization_panel <- potential_organization_records |>
  select(constituent_id) |>
  inner_join(donor_fiscal_year_panel, by = "constituent_id")

potential_organization_fy_summary <- organization_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    potential_organization_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    potential_organizations_with_positive_giving = sum(gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

donor_fiscal_year_entity_comparison <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(
    entity_group = if_else(
      constituent_id %in% potential_organization_records$constituent_id,
      "Potential organizations",
      "All other eligible constituents"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(entity_group) |>
  summarise(
    donor_fiscal_year_records = n(),
    distinct_constituents = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donor_years_with_positive_giving = sum(gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_years = sum(is_major_donor),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  potential_organization_fy_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(potential_organization_constituents,
               potential_organizations_with_positive_giving, major_donors),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  donor_fiscal_year_entity_comparison |>
    mutate(
      across(c(donor_fiscal_year_records, distinct_constituents,
               donor_years_with_positive_giving, major_donor_years),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

Exactly two constituents are explicitly classified as `Organization` in both
available type fields. Because this project ranks individual major-donor
prospects, these two records will be excluded from the final modeling panel.
The original Section 6B charts and summaries include these two organizations
and are retained as the pre-exclusion view.

```{r}
#| label: organization-exclusion-modeling-panel

organization_constituents <- constituents_analysis |>
  filter(
    primary_constituent_type == "Organization" |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(as.character(constituent_type), ""),
        regex("Organization", ignore_case = TRUE)
      )
  ) |>
  select(constituent_id, primary_constituent_type, constituent_type)

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id)

summarise_panel_group <- function(data, group_name) {
  tibble(
    group = group_name,
    distinct_constituents = n_distinct(data$constituent_id),
    donor_fiscal_year_rows = nrow(data),
    donor_years_with_positive_giving = sum(data$gave_this_year),
    total_annual_giving = sum(data$annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_years = sum(data$is_major_donor)
  )
}

excluded_organization_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id)

organization_exclusion_audit <- bind_rows(
  summarise_panel_group(donor_fiscal_year_panel,
                        "All eligible constituent records"),
  summarise_panel_group(excluded_organization_panel,
                        "Excluded organization records"),
  summarise_panel_group(modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel,
                        "Remaining individual constituent records")
)

knitr::kable(
  organization_exclusion_audit |>
    mutate(
      across(c(distinct_constituents, donor_fiscal_year_rows,
               donor_years_with_positive_giving, major_donor_years),
             scales::comma),
      total_annual_giving = scales::dollar(total_annual_giving)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

All future conversion-target and predictor analyses will use `modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel`.

### Time-aware eligible donor panel

A donor can enter the historical modeling population only after their first
positive, linked PBS Utah gift. Including a person before that first gift would
use future information and create data leakage.

```{r}
#| label: time-aware-eligible-donor-panel

first_giving_year <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  filter(annual_giving > 0) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(first_giving_year = min(fiscal_year_number), .groups = "drop")

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id) |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY"))) |>
  left_join(first_giving_year, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number >= first_giving_year) |>
  select(-fiscal_year_number)

time_aware_individual_panel_summary <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  time_aware_individual_panel_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

This time-aware individual panel will be used to create future conversion labels in Section 7.

### Legacy giving linkage check

Legacy payments are household-level and can link to up to seven constituents.
Before using them for historical donor eligibility or features, the analysis
must determine how often a gift links to one person versus multiple people.

```{r}
#| label: legacy-giving-linkage-check

legacy_id_columns <- paste0("constituent_id_", 1:7)

legacy_link_matrix <- legacy_payments_analysis |>
  select(all_of(legacy_id_columns)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  as.matrix()

legacy_link_present <- !is.na(legacy_link_matrix) &
  trimws(legacy_link_matrix) != ""
legacy_link_count <- rowSums(legacy_link_present)

legacy_linkage_summary <- tibble(
  linkage_group = case_when(
    legacy_link_count == 0 ~ "Zero linked constituents",
    legacy_link_count == 1 ~ "Exactly one linked constituent",
    legacy_link_count == 2 ~ "Two linked constituents",
    legacy_link_count >= 3 ~ "Three or more linked constituents"
  )
) |>
  count(linkage_group, name = "legacy_rows") |>
  mutate(percentage = legacy_rows / sum(legacy_rows)) |>
  arrange(factor(
    linkage_group,
    levels = c(
      "Zero linked constituents", "Exactly one linked constituent",
      "Two linked constituents", "Three or more linked constituents"
    )
  ))

legacy_position_summary <- tibble(
  linked_id_position = colnames(legacy_link_matrix),
  populated_rows = colSums(legacy_link_present),
  percentage_of_legacy_rows = populated_rows / nrow(legacy_link_matrix)
)

legacy_link_ids <- legacy_link_matrix[legacy_link_present]
constituent_ids <- as.character(constituents_analysis$constituent_id)
legacy_link_match_summary <- tibble(
  nonmissing_legacy_constituent_ids = length(legacy_link_ids),
  unmatched_legacy_constituent_ids = sum(!legacy_link_ids %in% constituent_ids),
  all_nonmissing_ids_match = all(legacy_link_ids %in% constituent_ids)
)

two_person_linkage_patterns <- tibble(
  linked_constituent_count = legacy_link_count,
  linkage_pattern = apply(
    legacy_link_present,
    1,
    function(position_present) {
      paste(colnames(legacy_link_matrix)[position_present], collapse = " + ")
    }
  )
) |>
  filter(linked_constituent_count == 2) |>
  count(linkage_pattern, name = "legacy_rows") |>
  arrange(desc(legacy_rows))

knitr::kable(
  legacy_linkage_summary |>
    mutate(legacy_rows = scales::comma(legacy_rows),
           percentage = scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1)),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  legacy_position_summary |>
    mutate(populated_rows = scales::comma(populated_rows),
           percentage_of_legacy_rows = scales::percent(
             percentage_of_legacy_rows,
             accuracy = 0.1
           )),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(legacy_link_match_summary, format = "pipe")
knitr::kable(two_person_linkage_patterns, format = "pipe")
```

The next step will document an allocation rule for usable legacy history.

### Legacy history allocation rule

The retained legacy rows are household-level. For individual-level historical
context, each retained record is assigned only to its primary
`constituent_id_1`. When a secondary linked constituent exists, the record is
flagged but still assigned only to the primary ID to avoid double counting;
this is a documented limitation.

```{r}
#| label: legacy-history-allocation

legacy_individual_history <- legacy_payments_analysis |>
  filter(!is.na(constituent_id_1), trimws(as.character(constituent_id_1)) != "") |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id_1),
    legacy_fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_from_date(gift_date)),
    gift_date,
    payment_amount,
    multiple_linked_constituents = !is.na(constituent_id_2) &
      trimws(as.character(constituent_id_2)) != ""
  )

legacy_no_linked_constituent_rows <- sum(legacy_link_count == 0)

legacy_history_audit <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Total legacy rows",
    "Rows excluded because no constituent is linked",
    "Rows assigned to a primary constituent",
    "Rows with multiple linked constituents",
    "Total legacy dollars assigned to primary constituent history"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(legacy_payments_analysis),
    legacy_no_linked_constituent_rows,
    nrow(legacy_individual_history),
    sum(legacy_individual_history$multiple_linked_constituents),
    sum(legacy_individual_history$payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

legacy_donor_summary <- legacy_individual_history |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(
    first_legacy_gift_date = min(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_legacy_gift_date = max(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    lifetime_legacy_giving = sum(payment_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    legacy_gift_count = n(),
    multiple_linked_constituents = any(multiple_linked_constituents),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  legacy_history_audit |>
    mutate(value = if_else(
      metric == "Total legacy dollars assigned to primary constituent history",
      scales::dollar(value),
      scales::comma(value)
    )),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

Legacy history will be used as prior context when finalizing the time-aware donor population and later features.

### Final time-aware individual donor panel

Eligibility now uses the earliest linked gift in either legacy history or
FY2021–FY2026 giving history. A donor is eligible in a fiscal year only if
their first known linked gift occurred on or before that fiscal year's June 30
end date.

```{r}
#| label: final-time-aware-individual-panel

combined_donor_history <- bind_rows(
  legacy_individual_history |>
    transmute(constituent_id, gift_date, history_source = "legacy"),
  constituent_giving_transactions |>
    transmute(
      constituent_id,
      gift_date = gift_credit_date,
      history_source = source
    )
)

first_known_gift <- combined_donor_history |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  summarise(first_known_gift_date = min(gift_date, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

modeling_fiscal_years <- donor_fiscal_year_giving |>
  distinct(fiscal_year) |>
  mutate(
    fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")),
    fiscal_year_end_date = as.Date(paste0(fiscal_year_number, "-06-30"))
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  constituent_id = setdiff(
    first_known_gift$constituent_id,
    organization_constituents$constituent_id
  ),
  modeling_fiscal_years
) |>
  left_join(first_known_gift, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(first_known_gift_date <= fiscal_year_end_date) |>
  left_join(donor_fiscal_year_giving, by = c("constituent_id", "fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(
    annual_giving = replace_na(annual_giving, 0),
    direct_payment_dollars = replace_na(direct_payment_dollars, 0),
    soft_credit_dollars = replace_na(soft_credit_dollars, 0),
    direct_payment_count = replace_na(direct_payment_count, 0L),
    soft_credit_count = replace_na(soft_credit_count, 0L),
    largest_gift = replace_na(largest_gift, 0),
    gave_this_year = annual_giving > 0,
    is_major_donor = annual_giving >= 1200,
    giving_tier = case_when(
      annual_giving == 0 ~ "No giving",
      annual_giving < 1200 ~ "Under $1,200",
      annual_giving < 2000 ~ "$1,200–$1,999",
      annual_giving < 5000 ~ "$2,000–$4,999",
      annual_giving < 10000 ~ "$5,000–$9,999",
      annual_giving < 15000 ~ "$10,000–$14,999",
      TRUE ~ "$15,000+"
    ),
    giving_tier = factor(
      giving_tier,
      levels = c(
        "No giving", "Under $1,200", "$1,200–$1,999", "$2,000–$4,999",
        "$5,000–$9,999", "$10,000–$14,999", "$15,000+"
      )
    )
  )

final_time_aware_panel_summary <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  group_by(fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_donors = n_distinct(constituent_id),
    donors_who_gave = sum(gave_this_year),
    major_donors = sum(is_major_donor),
    major_donor_percentage = major_donors / eligible_donors,
    total_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
    major_donor_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving[is_major_donor], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  final_time_aware_panel_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_donors, donors_who_gave, major_donors), scales::comma),
      major_donor_percentage = scales::percent(major_donor_percentage,
                                                accuracy = 0.1),
      across(c(total_annual_giving, major_donor_annual_giving), scales::dollar)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: primary-cohort-household-status

# Household status uses only reciprocal spouse links between known individual
# constituents. Unsupported links remain one-person households; the source has
# no relationship-effective dates, so supported links are a documented proxy.
individual_constituents <- constituents_analysis |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id),
    spouse_constituent_id = na_if(trimws(as.character(spouse_constituent_id)), ""),
    is_individual = !(
      primary_constituent_type == "Organization" |
        str_detect(coalesce(as.character(constituent_type), ""),
                   regex("Organization", ignore_case = TRUE))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(is_individual) |>
  select(-is_individual)

spouse_link_check <- individual_constituents |>
  filter(!is.na(spouse_constituent_id)) |>
  left_join(
    individual_constituents |>
      transmute(
        spouse_constituent_id = constituent_id,
        spouse_points_back = spouse_constituent_id
      ),
    by = "spouse_constituent_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    supported_reciprocal_link =
      !is.na(spouse_points_back) & spouse_points_back == constituent_id,
    self_link = spouse_constituent_id == constituent_id
  )

household_map <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  distinct(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id)) |>
  left_join(
    spouse_link_check |>
      select(constituent_id, spouse_constituent_id, supported_reciprocal_link),
    by = "constituent_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    supported_reciprocal_link = replace_na(supported_reciprocal_link, FALSE),
    household_id = if_else(
      supported_reciprocal_link,
      pmin(constituent_id, spouse_constituent_id),
      constituent_id
    )
  ) |>
  select(constituent_id, household_id, supported_reciprocal_link)

household_link_audit <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Constituents with a populated spouse link",
    "Supported reciprocal spouse-link rows",
    "Unsupported or nonreciprocal spouse-link rows",
    "Self-referential spouse-link rows"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(spouse_link_check),
    sum(spouse_link_check$supported_reciprocal_link),
    sum(!spouse_link_check$supported_reciprocal_link),
    sum(spouse_link_check$self_link)
  )
)

household_fiscal_year_giving <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id)) |>
  left_join(household_map, by = "constituent_id") |>
  group_by(household_id, fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(household_annual_giving = sum(annual_giving), .groups = "drop")

# Retained legacy records stay allocated to constituent_id_1. They provide
# pre-FY2021 major-history evidence without inferring unsupported households.
legacy_household_major_history <- legacy_individual_history |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id),
    legacy_fiscal_year,
    payment_amount
  ) |>
  inner_join(household_map, by = "constituent_id") |>
  group_by(household_id, legacy_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(legacy_household_annual_giving = sum(payment_amount), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(legacy_household_annual_giving >= 1200) |>
  distinct(household_id) |>
  mutate(has_legacy_major_history = TRUE)

modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(constituent_id = as.character(constituent_id)) |>
  left_join(household_map, by = "constituent_id") |>
  left_join(household_fiscal_year_giving, by = c("household_id", "fiscal_year")) |>
  left_join(legacy_household_major_history, by = "household_id") |>
  mutate(
    household_annual_giving = replace_na(household_annual_giving, 0),
    is_household_major_donor = household_annual_giving >= 1200,
    has_legacy_major_history = replace_na(has_legacy_major_history, FALSE)
  ) |>
  arrange(constituent_id, fiscal_year) |>
  group_by(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(
    prior_current_major_history = lag(cumany(is_household_major_donor),
                                      default = FALSE),
    former_major = has_legacy_major_history | prior_current_major_history,
    gave_in_prior_1y = lag(gave_this_year, 1, default = FALSE),
    gave_in_prior_2y = lag(gave_this_year, 2, default = FALSE),
    cohort_group = case_when(
      gave_this_year & !is_household_major_donor & !former_major ~
        "Primary active never-major",
      gave_this_year & !is_household_major_donor & former_major ~
        "Former-major reactivation",
      !gave_this_year & !is_household_major_donor &
        (gave_in_prior_1y | gave_in_prior_2y) ~ "Lapsed",
      is_household_major_donor ~ "Current household major",
      TRUE ~ "Other inactive"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

cohort_definition_checks <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "Primary/reactivation overlap",
    "Primary/reactivation rows are active non-major donors",
    "Lapsed rows are excluded from model cohorts"
  ),
  value = c(
    0L,
    sum(
      modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel$cohort_group %in%
        c("Primary active never-major", "Former-major reactivation") &
        (!modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel$gave_this_year |
          modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel$is_household_major_donor)
    ),
    0L
  )
)

stopifnot(all(cohort_definition_checks$value == 0))

knitr::kable(
  household_link_audit |>
    mutate(value = scales::comma(value)),
  caption = "Spouse-link support for household major-donor status"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: final-time-aware-panel-audit

legacy_history_donors <- legacy_individual_history |>
  distinct(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(has_legacy_history = TRUE)

current_history_donors <- constituent_giving_transactions |>
  distinct(constituent_id) |>
  mutate(has_current_history = TRUE)

history_source_audit <- full_join(
  legacy_history_donors,
  current_history_donors,
  by = "constituent_id"
) |>
  filter(!constituent_id %in% organization_constituents$constituent_id) |>
  mutate(
    history_group = case_when(
      has_legacy_history & !is.na(has_current_history) ~ "Donors with both histories",
      has_legacy_history ~ "Donors with only legacy history",
      TRUE ~ "Donors with only FY2021–FY2026 history"
    )
  ) |>
  count(history_group, name = "donors")

final_time_aware_panel_audit <- bind_rows(
  history_source_audit |>
    transmute(metric = history_group, value = donors),
  tibble(
    metric = "Final individual donors included in the panel",
    value = n_distinct(modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel$constituent_id)
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  final_time_aware_panel_audit |>
    mutate(value = scales::comma(value)),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

## 7. Target-variable EDA

### Twelve-month major-donor conversion

At the end of each fiscal year, the primary model cohort contains active
individual donors who are not currently household-major and have no prior major
history in the retained legacy or earlier fiscal-year record. Former-major
donors are reported separately as a reactivation cohort and are not included in
the primary model. Lapsed donors are also reported separately and are not
included in modeling.

```{r}
#| label: twelve-month-major-donor-conversion

snapshot_years <- paste0("FY", 2021:2025)

following_year_outcomes <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(
    fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_fiscal_year = paste0("FY", fiscal_year_number - 1)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year,
    following_year_annual_giving = annual_giving,
    following_year_is_major_donor = is_household_major_donor
  )

primary_conversion_12m_panel <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(
    fiscal_year %in% snapshot_years,
    cohort_group == "Primary active never-major"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_annual_giving = annual_giving
  ) |>
  left_join(
    following_year_outcomes,
    by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    converts_to_major_next_fy = following_year_is_major_donor
  )

reactivation_conversion_12m_panel <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(
    fiscal_year %in% snapshot_years,
    cohort_group == "Former-major reactivation"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_annual_giving = annual_giving
  ) |>
  left_join(following_year_outcomes,
            by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(converts_to_major_next_fy = following_year_is_major_donor)

lapsed_12m_panel <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  filter(fiscal_year %in% snapshot_years, cohort_group == "Lapsed") |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_annual_giving = annual_giving
  ) |>
  left_join(following_year_outcomes,
            by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")) |>
  mutate(converts_to_major_next_fy = following_year_is_major_donor)

# Keep the established name for downstream feature EDA; it now contains only
# the primary active never-major cohort.
conversion_12m_panel <- primary_conversion_12m_panel

conversion_12m_summary <- primary_conversion_12m_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    primary_never_major_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

conversion_12m_overall_summary <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  summarise(
    primary_never_major_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate
  )

reactivation_12m_summary <- reactivation_conversion_12m_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    former_major_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

lapsed_12m_summary <- lapsed_12m_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    lapsed_donors = n(),
    twelve_month_converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_next_fy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

knitr::kable(
  conversion_12m_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(primary_never_major_donors, twelve_month_converters),
             scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_12m_overall_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(primary_never_major_donors, twelve_month_converters),
             scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
  ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  reactivation_12m_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(former_major_donors, twelve_month_converters), scales::comma),
      conversion_rate = scales::percent(conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  caption = "Former-major reactivation cohort: 12-month household-major conversion"
)
knitr::kable(
  lapsed_12m_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(lapsed_donors, twelve_month_converters), scales::comma),
      conversion_rate = scales::percent(conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  caption = "Lapsed donors: reporting-only 12-month household-major base rate"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: twelve-month-conversion-rate-plot

ggplot(conversion_12m_summary,
       aes(x = snapshot_fiscal_year, y = conversion_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title = "Twelve-month major-donor conversion rate by snapshot fiscal year",
    x = "Snapshot fiscal year",
    y = "12-month conversion rate"
  )
```

Twelve-month conversion is a rare outcome, so majority-class accuracy is not a useful measure of prospect-ranking quality.

### Three- and five-year major-donor conversion

A donor is a longer-term converter if they are not a major donor at the
snapshot date but reach at least $1,200 in annual giving in any future fiscal
year within the stated horizon. Complete 3-year follow-up is available for
FY2021–FY2023, while complete 5-year follow-up is available only for FY2021.
Therefore, the 3-year target can be explored across multiple years, but the
5-year result is descriptive rather than a robust model-validation sample.

```{r}
#| label: three-and-five-year-conversion

modeling_panel_with_year_number <- modeling_donor_fiscal_year_panel |>
  mutate(fiscal_year_number = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(fiscal_year, "FY")))

conversion_3y_panel <- modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number %in% 2021:2023, !is_major_donor) |>
  transmute(
    constituent_id,
    snapshot_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
    snapshot_year_number = fiscal_year_number
  ) |>
  left_join(
    modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
      transmute(
        constituent_id,
        future_year_number = fiscal_year_number,
        future_annual_giving = annual_giving
      ),
    by = "constituent_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(
    future_year_number > snapshot_year_number,
    future_year_number <= snapshot_year_number + 3
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year, snapshot_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    converts_to_major_within_3y = any(future_annual_giving >= 1200),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conversion_3y_summary <- conversion_3y_panel |>
  group_by(snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    three_year_converters = sum(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(snapshot_fiscal_year)

conversion_3y_overall_summary <- conversion_3y_panel |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors = n(),
    three_year_converters = sum(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    conversion_rate = mean(converts_to_major_within_3y),
    majority_class_baseline_accuracy = 1 - conversion_rate
  )

conversion_5y_fy2021_summary <- modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
  filter(fiscal_year_number == 2021, !is_major_donor) |>
  transmute(constituent_id) |>
  left_join(
    modeling_panel_with_year_number |>
      filter(fiscal_year_number %in% 2022:2026) |>
      group_by(constituent_id) |>
      summarise(
        becomes_major_within_5y = any(annual_giving >= 1200),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "constituent_id"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021 = n(),
    five_year_converters = sum(becomes_major_within_5y, na.rm = TRUE),
    five_year_conversion_rate = five_year_converters /
      eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021
  )

knitr::kable(
  conversion_3y_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, three_year_converters), scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_3y_overall_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors, three_year_converters), scales::comma),
      across(c(conversion_rate, majority_class_baseline_accuracy),
             scales::percent, accuracy = 0.001)
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
knitr::kable(
  conversion_5y_fy2021_summary |>
    mutate(
      across(c(eligible_non_major_donors_fy2021, five_year_converters),
             scales::comma),
      five_year_conversion_rate = scales::percent(
        five_year_conversion_rate,
        accuracy = 0.001
      )
    ),
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: three-year-conversion-rate-plot

ggplot(conversion_3y_summary,
       aes(x = snapshot_fiscal_year, y = conversion_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title = "Three-year major-donor conversion rate by snapshot fiscal year",
    x = "Snapshot fiscal year",
    y = "Three-year conversion rate"
  )
```

## 8. Predictor EDA

```{r}
# End-of-data constituent snapshot fields are retained in the raw table for
# descriptive audit only; they are never eligible to enter predictor features.
predictor_blocklist <- c(
  "major_donor_class_pbs_utah",
  "annual_giving_group",
  "sustainer_pbs_utah",
  "lifetime_uof_u_fundraising",
  "previous_fy_uof_u_cash",
  "prospect_committed_giving_amount_uof_u"
)

stopifnot(all(predictor_blocklist %in% names(constituents_analysis)))
```

## Giving-history features

Every predictor must use information available on or before the snapshot fiscal-year end date. Future giving must never be used to predict conversion. These features use only individual-level legacy and current giving transactions dated by each donor-year snapshot.

```{r}
# Build RFM features efficiently from donor × fiscal-year summaries.
# All snapshots occur at the end of a PBS Utah fiscal year (June 30).

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_end_date = as.Date(paste0(snapshot_year_number, "-06-30"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

giving_history_transactions <- bind_rows(
  legacy_individual_history |>
    transmute(
      constituent_id,
      gift_date,
      amount = payment_amount,
      gift_fiscal_year = legacy_fiscal_year,
      source = "legacy"
    ),
  constituent_giving_transactions |>
    transmute(
      constituent_id,
      gift_date = gift_credit_date,
      amount,
      gift_fiscal_year = fiscal_year,
      source
    )
)

# Aggregate raw gift history once, rather than once for every donor-year row.
history_by_fiscal_year <- giving_history_transactions |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(gift_date), !is.na(amount)) |>
  mutate(
    gift_fiscal_year_number = as.integer(
      str_remove(gift_fiscal_year, "FY")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, gift_fiscal_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_giving = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    fiscal_year_gift_count = n(),
    fiscal_year_largest_gift = max(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_gift_date_in_fy = min(gift_date),
    last_gift_date_in_fy = max(gift_date),
    legacy_giving_in_fy = any(source == "legacy"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build one feature table per snapshot year, then combine them.
rfm_runtime <- system.time({

  rfm_predictor_eda <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      snapshot_candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      # This table is already aggregated to donor × fiscal year.
      # It is much smaller than raw transaction history.
      history_to_snapshot <- history_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(gift_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          giving_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          giving_last_36m = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          giving_previous_two_years = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 2 &
                gift_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number - 1
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          years_given_last_5 = n_distinct(
            gift_fiscal_year_number[
              gift_fiscal_year_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 4 &
                gift_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number
            ]
          ),
          giving_previous_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_giving[
              gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number - 1
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          gift_count_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_gift_count[
              gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_giving_to_date = sum(fiscal_year_giving, na.rm = TRUE),
          lifetime_gift_count = sum(fiscal_year_gift_count, na.rm = TRUE),
          largest_prior_gift = max(fiscal_year_largest_gift, na.rm = TRUE),
          first_known_gift_date = min(first_gift_date_in_fy),
          last_known_gift_date = max(last_gift_date_in_fy),
          had_legacy_giving_history = any(legacy_giving_in_fy),
          gave_in_snapshot_year = any(
            gift_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      snapshot_candidates |>
        left_join(history_to_snapshot, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          giving_last_12m = replace_na(giving_last_12m, 0),
          giving_last_36m = replace_na(giving_last_36m, 0),
          giving_previous_two_years = replace_na(giving_previous_two_years, 0),
          years_given_last_5 = replace_na(years_given_last_5, 0L),
          giving_previous_12m = replace_na(giving_previous_12m, 0),
          gift_count_last_12m = replace_na(gift_count_last_12m, 0L),
          lifetime_giving_to_date = replace_na(lifetime_giving_to_date, 0),
          lifetime_gift_count = replace_na(lifetime_gift_count, 0L),
          largest_prior_gift = replace_na(largest_prior_gift, 0),
          gave_in_snapshot_year = replace_na(gave_in_snapshot_year, FALSE),
          had_legacy_giving_history = replace_na(
            had_legacy_giving_history, FALSE
          ),
          months_since_last_gift = if_else(
            !is.na(last_known_gift_date),
            interval(last_known_gift_date, snapshot_end_date) %/% months(1),
            NA_integer_
          ),
          days_since_last_gift = if_else(
            !is.na(last_known_gift_date),
            as.integer(snapshot_end_date - last_known_gift_date),
            NA_integer_
          ),
          donor_tenure_years = if_else(
            !is.na(first_known_gift_date),
            time_length(
              interval(first_known_gift_date, snapshot_end_date),
              "years"
            ),
            NA_real_
          )
        ) |>
        select(-first_known_gift_date, -last_known_gift_date) |>
        mutate(giving_change_from_last_year =
          giving_last_12m - giving_previous_12m)
    }
  )
})

rfm_runtime

# Validation: these must match the target panel exactly.
stopifnot(nrow(rfm_predictor_eda) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

rfm_duplicate_keys <- rfm_predictor_eda |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(rfm_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```

## Campaign-history features

Campaign history may reflect both donor engagement and staff targeting. The summaries below are therefore descriptive associations, not evidence that a campaign caused a future major gift.

```{r}
# Build campaign features efficiently from constituent × fiscal-year summaries.
# Do not join raw campaign records to the donor-year target panel.

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY")),
    snapshot_end_date = as.Date(paste0(snapshot_year_number, "-06-30"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

# Keep only columns needed for campaign features and only relevant constituents.
campaign_history_small <- campaign_members_analysis |>
  select(constituent_id, marketing_code, campaign_start_date, responded_date) |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  left_join(
    campaign_codes_analysis |>
      select(marketing_code, communication_method),
    by = "marketing_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    campaign_start_date = as.Date(campaign_start_date),
    responded_date = as.Date(responded_date),
    campaign_fy_number = fiscal_year_from_date(campaign_start_date),
    response_fy_number = fiscal_year_from_date(responded_date)
  )

# Aggregate solicitations once by constituent and fiscal year.
campaign_by_fiscal_year <- campaign_history_small |>
  filter(!is.na(campaign_start_date)) |>
  arrange(constituent_id, campaign_start_date, marketing_code) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, campaign_fy_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_solicitations = n(),
    communication_method_in_fy = last(
      communication_method[!is.na(communication_method)],
      default = NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Aggregate responses once by response fiscal year.
# Response timing, not campaign-start timing, determines whether it was known.
responses_by_fiscal_year <- campaign_history_small |>
  filter(!is.na(responded_date)) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, response_fy_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_responses = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

campaign_runtime <- system.time({

  campaign_features <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      solicitation_summary <- campaign_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(campaign_fy_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          solicitations_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_solicitations[
              campaign_fy_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          solicitations_last_36m = sum(
            fiscal_year_solicitations[
              campaign_fy_number >= .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_solicitations = sum(fiscal_year_solicitations, na.rm = TRUE),
          most_recent_communication_method = last(
            communication_method_in_fy[
              !is.na(communication_method_in_fy)
            ],
            default = NA_character_
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      response_summary <- responses_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(response_fy_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          campaign_responses_last_12m = sum(
            fiscal_year_responses[
              response_fy_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
            ],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_responses = sum(
            fiscal_year_responses,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      candidates |>
        left_join(solicitation_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        left_join(response_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          solicitations_last_12m = replace_na(
            solicitations_last_12m, 0L
          ),
          solicitations_last_36m = replace_na(
            solicitations_last_36m, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_solicitations = replace_na(
            lifetime_solicitations, 0L
          ),
          campaign_responses_last_12m = replace_na(
            campaign_responses_last_12m, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_responses = replace_na(
            lifetime_campaign_responses, 0L
          ),
          lifetime_campaign_response_rate = if_else(
            lifetime_solicitations > 0,
            lifetime_campaign_responses / lifetime_solicitations,
            NA_real_
          ),
          responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m =
            campaign_responses_last_12m > 0
        )
    }
  )
})

campaign_runtime

# Validation checks
stopifnot(nrow(campaign_features) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

campaign_duplicate_keys <- campaign_features |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(campaign_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```

    pct_responding_last_12m = mean(responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_campaign_responses_to_date = median(lifetime_campaign_responses, na.rm = TRUE),

         converts_to_major_next_fy = if_else(converts_to_major_next_fy, "Future converter", "Did not convert"))

## Passport viewing features

Passport data is available only for linked or consenting viewing records. A missing Passport record does not mean that a donor did not engage with PBS Utah, so coverage is reported separately from viewing behavior. These results assess incremental association rather than complete audience engagement.

```{r}
# Build Passport features efficiently from constituent × fiscal-year summaries.
# Missing Passport data remains missing; it is not converted to zero viewing.

candidate_base <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  mutate(
    snapshot_year_number = as.integer(str_remove(snapshot_fiscal_year, "FY"))
  )

candidate_ids <- candidate_base |>
  distinct(constituent_id)

passport_by_fiscal_year <- passport_viewing_analysis |>
  semi_join(candidate_ids, by = "constituent_id") |>
  mutate(
    passport_fiscal_year_number = as.integer(
      str_remove(as.character(fiscal_year), "FY")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(constituent_id, passport_fiscal_year_number) |>
  summarise(
    fiscal_year_titles_viewed = sum(titles_viewed, na.rm = TRUE),
    fiscal_year_distinct_genres = n_distinct(genre),
    fiscal_year_mean_percent_watched = mean(
      mean_percent_watched,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passport_runtime <- system.time({

  passport_features <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(candidate_base$snapshot_year_number)),
    function(snapshot_year_number) {

      candidates <- candidate_base |>
        filter(snapshot_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number)

      passport_summary <- passport_by_fiscal_year |>
        filter(passport_fiscal_year_number <= .env$snapshot_year_number) |>
        group_by(constituent_id) |>
        summarise(
          passport_record_available = TRUE,
          titles_viewed_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_titles_viewed[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          titles_viewed_last_36m = if_else(
            any(
              passport_fiscal_year_number >=
                .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
            ),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_titles_viewed[
                passport_fiscal_year_number >=
                  .env$snapshot_year_number - 2
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          distinct_genres_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            sum(
              fiscal_year_distinct_genres[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_integer_
          ),
          mean_percent_watched_last_12m = if_else(
            any(passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number),
            mean(
              fiscal_year_mean_percent_watched[
                passport_fiscal_year_number == .env$snapshot_year_number
              ],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ),
            NA_real_
          ),
          passport_viewing_recency_years = .env$snapshot_year_number -
            max(passport_fiscal_year_number),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      candidates |>
        left_join(passport_summary, by = "constituent_id") |>
        mutate(
          passport_record_available = replace_na(
            passport_record_available,
            FALSE
          )
        )
    }
  )
})

passport_runtime

# Validation checks
stopifnot(nrow(passport_features) == nrow(conversion_12m_panel))

passport_duplicate_keys <- passport_features |>
  count(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(passport_duplicate_keys) == 0)
```

## Joined donor-year feature table

All transactional sources were first aggregated to the same donor-year grain before joining. This prevents raw payment, campaign, or Passport rows from creating duplicate model records.

```{r}
# Join only donor-year summaries to the conversion outcome table.
base_rows <- nrow(conversion_12m_panel)
eda_feature_table <- conversion_12m_panel |>
  left_join(rfm_predictor_eda |>
    select(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year, giving_last_12m,
           giving_last_36m, gift_count_last_12m, lifetime_giving_to_date,
           lifetime_gift_count, largest_prior_gift, months_since_last_gift,
           donor_tenure_years, gave_in_snapshot_year, had_legacy_giving_history),
    by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")) |>
  left_join(campaign_features |>
    select(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year, solicitations_last_12m,
           solicitations_last_36m, campaign_responses_last_12m,
           lifetime_campaign_responses, lifetime_campaign_response_rate,
           responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m),
    by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year")) |>
  left_join(passport_features |>
    select(constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year, passport_record_available,
           titles_viewed_last_12m, titles_viewed_last_36m,
           distinct_genres_last_12m, mean_percent_watched_last_12m,
           passport_viewing_recency_years),
    by = c("constituent_id", "snapshot_fiscal_year"))

stopifnot(!any(predictor_blocklist %in% names(eda_feature_table)))

join_checks <- tibble(
  check = c("Rows before joins", "Rows after joins", "Unique donor-year keys", "Outcome fields retained"),
  value = c(base_rows, nrow(eda_feature_table),
            nrow(distinct(eda_feature_table, constituent_id, snapshot_fiscal_year)),
            sum(names(eda_feature_table) == "converts_to_major_next_fy"))
)
knitr::kable(join_checks, caption = "Joined feature-table checks")
```

```{r}
rfm_cols <- c("giving_last_12m", "giving_last_36m", "lifetime_giving_to_date", "largest_prior_gift")
campaign_cols <- c("solicitations_last_12m", "campaign_responses_last_12m", "lifetime_campaign_responses")
passport_cols <- c("titles_viewed_last_12m", "distinct_genres_last_12m", "mean_percent_watched_last_12m")

feature_coverage <- tibble(
  feature_group = c("RFM", "Campaign", "Passport"),
  usable_records = c(sum(rowSums(!is.na(eda_feature_table[rfm_cols])) > 0),
                     sum(rowSums(!is.na(eda_feature_table[campaign_cols])) > 0),
                     sum(rowSums(!is.na(eda_feature_table[passport_cols])) > 0)),
  coverage = usable_records / nrow(eda_feature_table),
  missingness_treatment = c("Zeros represent no observed giving; recency fields may be missing.",
                            "No recorded campaign activity remains missing.",
                            "Missing coverage is distinct from zero viewing; do not recode as zero.")
) |>
  mutate(coverage = scales::percent(coverage, accuracy = 0.1))
knitr::kable(feature_coverage, caption = "Candidate predictor coverage")

candidate_cols <- c(rfm_cols, "gift_count_last_12m", "months_since_last_gift", "donor_tenure_years",
                    campaign_cols, "lifetime_campaign_response_rate", "responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m",
                    passport_cols, "titles_viewed_last_36m", "passport_viewing_recency_years")
missingness_table <- eda_feature_table |>
  summarise(across(all_of(candidate_cols), ~sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "feature", values_to = "missing_records") |>
  mutate(pct_missing = missing_records / nrow(eda_feature_table)) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_missing)) |>
  mutate(pct_missing = scales::percent(pct_missing, accuracy = 0.1))
knitr::kable(missingness_table, caption = "Missingness in candidate predictors")
```

Passport coverage is reported in two complementary ways. The 30.8% value used
in the evidence summary is the share of donor-years with any prior Passport
record. The 15.3% value in the candidate-predictor coverage table is the share
with usable values across the selected snapshot-specific Passport metrics.
Missing Passport data remains distinct from zero viewing. Any imputation or
encoding will occur inside time-based model training rather than during EDA.

## Predictor EDA findings

The table below consolidates evidence from the donor-year feature summaries. Coverage and conversion-rate differences are computed from the available data; they are preliminary associations and should not be interpreted as causal effects.

```{r}
# Create a compact evidence summary from the completed Section 8 results.
# The outcome is always converts_to_major_next_fy.
# Campaign response and Passport availability are the comparison groups.

# ----- RFM: compare continuous feature medians by outcome -----

rfm_medians <- rfm_predictor_eda |>
  group_by(converts_to_major_next_fy) |>
  summarise(
    median_giving_last_12m = median(giving_last_12m, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_months_since_last_gift = median(
      months_since_last_gift,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rfm_non_converter <- rfm_medians |>
  filter(!converts_to_major_next_fy)

rfm_converter <- rfm_medians |>
  filter(converts_to_major_next_fy)

rfm_comparison_text <- paste0(
  "Median last-12-month giving: ",
  scales::dollar(rfm_converter$median_giving_last_12m),
  " vs ",
  scales::dollar(rfm_non_converter$median_giving_last_12m),
  "; median recency: ",
  round(rfm_converter$median_months_since_last_gift, 0),
  " vs ",
  round(rfm_non_converter$median_months_since_last_gift, 0),
  " months"
)

# ----- Campaign: compare conversion rate for responders vs non-responders -----

campaign_rates <- campaign_features |>
  group_by(responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m) |>
  summarise(
    donor_years = n(),
    converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy),
    conversion_rate = mean(as.numeric(converts_to_major_next_fy)),
    median_solicitations_last_12m = median(
      solicitations_last_12m,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

campaign_no_response <- campaign_rates |>
  filter(!responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m)

campaign_response <- campaign_rates |>
  filter(responded_to_any_campaign_last_12m)

campaign_difference_pp <- 100 * (
  campaign_response$conversion_rate -
    campaign_no_response$conversion_rate
)

campaign_comparison_text <- paste0(
  "Responded: ",
  scales::percent(campaign_response$conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001),
  " conversion vs ",
  scales::percent(campaign_no_response$conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001),
  " without a response"
)

# ----- Passport: compare conversion rate with vs without a prior record -----

passport_rates <- passport_features |>
  group_by(passport_record_available) |>
  summarise(
    donor_years = n(),
    converters = sum(converts_to_major_next_fy),
    conversion_rate = mean(as.numeric(converts_to_major_next_fy)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passport_no_record <- passport_rates |>
  filter(!passport_record_available)

passport_record <- passport_rates |>
  filter(passport_record_available)

passport_difference_pp <- 100 * (
  passport_record$conversion_rate -
    passport_no_record$conversion_rate
)

passport_behavior <- passport_features |>
  filter(!is.na(titles_viewed_last_12m)) |>
  group_by(converts_to_major_next_fy) |>
  summarise(
    median_titles_viewed = median(titles_viewed_last_12m, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passport_non_converter <- passport_behavior |>
  filter(!converts_to_major_next_fy)

passport_converter <- passport_behavior |>
  filter(converts_to_major_next_fy)

passport_coverage <- mean(
  passport_features$passport_record_available,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

passport_comparison_text <- paste0(
  "Prior Passport record: ",
  scales::percent(passport_record$conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001),
  " conversion vs ",
  scales::percent(passport_no_record$conversion_rate, accuracy = 0.001),
  "; among current viewers, median titles: ",
  round(passport_converter$median_titles_viewed, 0),
  " vs ",
  round(passport_non_converter$median_titles_viewed, 0)
)

# ----- Final evidence table -----

evidence_table <- tibble(
  feature_group = c(
    "Giving-history / RFM",
    "Campaign history",
    "Passport viewing"
  ),
  coverage = c(
    "100.0%",
    "100.0% feature availability",
    scales::percent(passport_coverage, accuracy = 0.1)
  ),
  converter_comparison = c(
    rfm_comparison_text,
    campaign_comparison_text,
    passport_comparison_text
  ),
  conversion_rate_difference = c(
    "—",
    paste0(round(campaign_difference_pp, 3), " percentage points"),
    paste0(round(passport_difference_pp, 3), " percentage points")
  ),
  preliminary_assessment = c(
    "Strongest preliminary signals; test in time-based models.",
    "Promising, but staff-targeting bias is possible.",
    "Potentially useful, but coverage is limited and missingness is ambiguous."
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  evidence_table,
  caption = "Evidence summary for candidate feature groups"
)
```

Recent giving and recency show the strongest association with 12-month major-donor conversion. Future converters gave a median of $600 in the prior 12 months and had given within 1 month, compared with $0 and 66 months for non-converters.
Campaign response also appears useful. Donors who responded to a campaign in the prior 12 months converted at 0.244%, compared with 0.030% for non-responders, although this may partly reflect staff targeting.
Passport data may add information beyond giving history. Donors with a prior Passport record converted at 0.093%, compared with 0.026% without one; among current viewers, future converters viewed a median of 40 titles versus 25. Any-prior-record coverage is 30.8% of donor-years, while 15.3% have usable values across the selected snapshot-specific Passport metrics; missing data should not be treated as no engagement.

## 9. Limitations and EDA handoff

The primary active never-major 12-month outcome is rare: 131 of 159,968
eligible donor-years converted (0.082%). Three-year conversion can be observed
only for FY2021–FY2023, and a complete five-year window is available only for
FY2021. Legacy payments are household-level and are assigned to the primary
linked constituent to avoid double counting. Passport coverage is incomplete;
a missing record can mean no linked account, no consent, or no viewing rather
than low engagement. Campaign response can reflect prior staff targeting as
well as donor propensity.

Predictive modeling, time-based validation, and final workflow
recommendations are documented in `pbs_utah_modeling.qmd`.

## 10. AI Use Note

I used ChatGPT and Codex for this EDA assignment. I provided instructions,
reviewed outputs, and made decisions while AI tools wrote the majority of the
code.
